levels.title: Check the small cases
levels.body_md: Take a look at your main check for the smallest inputs. Does it handle the smallest even weight correctly?
levels.question_back: What should happen for the smallest even weight?

levels.title: Think about splitting evenly
levels.body_md: A split needs two positive even parts. So think about what is the smallest total that allows that.

levels.title: Your condition looks right
levels.body_md: Your check in `L6` with `w % 2 == 0 && w > 2` covers this well. It prints `YES` only for even totals above two, else `NO`. I see no failing input here.

levels.title: Why your logic works
levels.body_md: You need two positive even numbers that sum to w. The smallest such pair is two plus two, so w must be at least four. Any even w from four up can be split as two and w minus two, which stays even and positive. Your test in `L6` exactly captures even and greater than two. No change is needed, and it runs in `O(1)` time and memory.
